var C_RESET    = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[0m";
var C_BOLD     = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[1m";
var C_DIM      = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[2m";
var C_UNDER    = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[4m";
var C_RED      = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[31m";
var C_GREEN    = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[32m";
var C_YELLOW   = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[33m";
var C_BLUE     = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[34m";
var C_MAGENTA  = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[35m";
var C_CYAN     = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[36m";
var C_WHITE    = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[37m";
var C_BG_RED   = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[41m";
var C_BG_GRN   = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[42m";
var C_BG_YEL   = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[43m";
var C_BG_BLU   = String.fromCharCode(27) + "[44m";
function color(txt, c) { return c + String(txt) + C_RESET; }
function rojo(t)      { return color(t, C_RED); }
function verde(t)     { return color(t, C_GREEN); }
function amarillo(t)  { return color(t, C_YELLOW); }
function azul(t)      { return color(t, C_BLUE); }
function magenta(t)   { return color(t, C_MAGENTA); }
function cyan(t)      { return color(t, C_CYAN); }
function dim(t)       { return color(t, C_DIM); }
function bold(t)      { return color(t, C_BOLD); }
function tituloC(t)   { return C_BOLD + C_CYAN + String(t) + C_RESET; }
function ok(t)        { return C_GREEN + "[OK] " + String(t) + C_RESET; }
function errorC(t)    { return C_RED + "[ERROR] " + String(t) + C_RESET; }
function warnC(t)     { return C_YELLOW + "[!] " + String(t) + C_RESET; }
function infoC(t)     { return C_CYAN + "[i] " + String(t) + C_RESET; }
function pregunta(t)  { return C_BOLD + C_MAGENTA + String(t) + C_RESET; }
var APP_DIR_NAME = "SistemaGestion";
function getAppDataDir() {
    var sh = new ActiveXObject("WScript.Shell");
    var appdata = sh.ExpandEnvironmentStrings("%APPDATA%");
    return appdata + "\\" + APP_DIR_NAME;
}
function asegurarDir(p) {
    var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
    if (!fso.FolderExists(p)) { fso.CreateFolder(p); }
    var bk = p + "\\Backups";
    if (!fso.FolderExists(bk)) { fso.CreateFolder(bk); }
    return p;
}
function saveFile(p, content) {
    var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
    var ts = fso.OpenTextFile(p, 2, true, -1);
    ts.Write(content); ts.Close();
}
function readFile(p) {
    var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
    if (!fso.FileExists(p)) return "";
    var ts = fso.OpenTextFile(p, 1, false, -1);
    var c = ts.ReadAll(); ts.Close(); return c;
}
function appendFile(p, content) {
    var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
    var ts = fso.OpenTextFile(p, 8, true, -1);
    ts.Write(content); ts.Close();
}
function fileExists(p) {
    var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
    return fso.FileExists(p);
}
function guardarEstado() {
    var dir = asegurarDir(getAppDataDir());
    var estado = {
        fecha: isoStr(),
        catalogo: CATALOGO,
        clientes: CLIENTES,
        ventas: VENTAS,
        caja: CAJA_ACTUAL,
        version: "2.0"
    };
    try { saveFile(dir + "\\estado.json", JSON.stringify(estado)); return true; } catch(e) { return false; }
}
function cargarEstado() {
    var p = getAppDataDir() + "\\estado.json";
    if (!fileExists(p)) return null;
    var raw = readFile(p);
    try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e) { return null; }
}
function logVenta(v) {
    var dir = asegurarDir(getAppDataDir());
    appendFile(dir + "\\ventas.log", JSON.stringify(v) + "\r\n");
}
function logLinea(linea) {
    var dir = asegurarDir(getAppDataDir());
    appendFile(dir + "\\actividad.log", isoStr() + " | " + linea + "\r\n");
}
function logError(ctx, e) {
    var dir = asegurarDir(getAppDataDir());
    appendFile(dir + "\\errores.log", isoStr() + " | " + ctx + " | " + e.message + "\r\n");
}
function md5(s) {
    try {
        var h = 5381;
        for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h = ((h << 5) + h) + s.charCodeAt(i); h = h & 0xFFFFFFFF; }
        var h2 = 0;
        for (var j = s.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) { h2 = ((h2 << 7) + h2) ^ s.charCodeAt(j); h2 = h2 & 0xFFFFFFFF; }
        return (("00000000" + (h >>> 0).toString(16)).slice(-8)) + (("00000000" + (h2 >>> 0).toString(16)).slice(-8));
    } catch(e) { return "ERR"; }
}
function md5hex(s) {
    var h = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h = ((h << 5) - h) + s.charCodeAt(i); h = h & h; }
    return ("00000000" + (Math.abs(h) >>> 0).toString(16)).slice(-8);
}
function hashCatalogo() {
    var s = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < CATALOGO.length; i++) s += CATALOGO[i].codigo + ":" + CATALOGO[i].precio + ";" + CATALOGO[i].stock + "|";
    return md5(s);
}
function integridadCatalogo() {
    var h = hashCatalogo();
    logLinea("Integridad hash=" + h + " items=" + CATALOGO.length);
    return h;
}
function ymd() { var d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + pad(d.getMonth()+1, 2) + pad(d.getDate(), 2); }
function hms() { var d = new Date(); return pad(d.getHours(), 2) + pad(d.getMinutes(), 2) + pad(d.getSeconds(), 2); }
function ymdhms() { return ymd() + "_" + hms(); }
function centerTxt(t, w) {
    var p = Math.floor((w - String(t).length) / 2);
    var sp = ""; for (var i = 0; i < Math.max(0, p); i++) sp += " ";
    return sp + t;
}
function truncar(s, n) { if (s.length <= n) return s; return s.substring(0, n - 1) + "..."; }
function generarNumeroTicket() {
    var d = new Date();
    return "TKT-" + d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth()+1, 2) + pad(d.getDate(), 2) + "-" +
           pad(d.getHours(), 2) + pad(d.getMinutes(), 2) + pad(d.getSeconds(), 2) + "-" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9999);
}
function formatearTicket(carrito, cliente, total, descuento, ivaPct) {
    var w = 42; var sep = ""; for (var i = 0; i < w; i++) sep += "=";
    var sepD = ""; for (var i = 0; i < w; i++) sepD += "-";
    var lineas = [];
    lineas.push(sep);
    lineas.push(centerTxt("*** SISTEMA DE GESTION ***", w));
    lineas.push(sep);
    lineas.push("Ticket Nro: " + generarNumeroTicket());
    lineas.push("Fecha     : " + nowStr());
    lineas.push("Cliente   : " + (cliente || "Consumidor Final"));
    if (descuento > 0) lineas.push("Descuento : " + descuento + "%");
    lineas.push(sepD);
    lineas.push(padR("Producto", 22) + pad("Cant", 5) + pad("Subtotal", 8));
    lineas.push(sepD);
    for (var i = 0; i < carrito.length; i++) {
        var item = carrito[i];
        lineas.push(padR(truncar(item.nombre, 22), 22) + pad(String(item.cant), 5) + pad("$" + item.subtotal.toFixed(2), 8));
    }
    lineas.push(sepD);
    var subtotal = total;
    var descVal = descuento > 0 ? subtotal * (descuento / 100) : 0;
    var gravado = subtotal - descVal;
    var iva = gravado * ((ivaPct || 21) / 100);
    lineas.push(padR("Subtotal:", 30) + pad("$" + subtotal.toFixed(2), 8));
    if (descuento > 0) lineas.push(padR("Descuento:", 30) + pad("-$" + descVal.toFixed(2), 8));
    lineas.push(padR("IVA " + (ivaPct || 21) + "%:", 30) + pad("$" + iva.toFixed(2), 8));
    lineas.push(padR("TOTAL:", 30) + pad("$" + (gravado + iva).toFixed(2), 8));
    lineas.push(sep);
    lineas.push(centerTxt("Gracias!", w));
    lineas.push(sep);
    return lineas.join("\r\n");
}
function imprimirTicketGuardado(contenido, etiqueta) {
    var dir = asegurarDir(getAppDataDir());
    var nombre = (etiqueta || "ticket") + "_" + new Date().getTime() + ".txt";
    var p = dir + "\\" + nombre;
    saveFile(p, contenido); return p;
}
function escapeCSV(v) {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return "";
    var s = String(v);
    if (s.indexOf(",") >= 0 || s.indexOf("\"") >= 0 || s.indexOf("\n") >= 0) return "\"" + s.replace(/"/g, "\"\"") + "\"";
    return s;
}
function exportarCatalogoCSV() {
    var dir = asegurarDir(getAppDataDir()); var p = dir + "\\catalogo_" + ymd() + ".csv";
    var lines = ["codigo,nombre,categoria,precio,costo,margen,stock,estado"];
    for (var i = 0; i < CATALOGO.length; i++) {
        var x = CATALOGO[i];
        var margen = x.precio - (x.costo || 0);
        lines.push([escapeCSV(x.codigo), escapeCSV(x.nombre), escapeCSV(x.categoria || x.depto || ""), x.precio, x.costo || 0, margen, x.stock, x.estado || ""].join(","));
    }
    saveFile(p, lines.join("\r\n")); return p;
}
function exportarStockBajoCSV() {
    var dir = asegurarDir(getAppDataDir()); var p = dir + "\\stock_bajo_" + ymd() + ".csv";
    var lines = ["codigo,nombre,categoria,stock,estado"];
    for (var i = 0; i < CATALOGO.length; i++) {
        if (CATALOGO[i].stock < 5) {
            var x = CATALOGO[i];
            lines.push([escapeCSV(x.codigo), escapeCSV(x.nombre), escapeCSV(x.categoria || x.depto || ""), x.stock, x.estado || ""].join(","));
        }
    }
    saveFile(p, lines.join("\r\n")); return p;
}
function exportarVentasCSV() {
    var dir = asegurarDir(getAppDataDir()); var p = dir + "\\ventas_" + ymd() + ".csv";
    var lines = ["ticket,fecha,cliente,producto,cant,precio,subtotal"];
    for (var i = 0; i < VENTAS.length; i++) {
        var v = VENTAS[i];
        for (var j = 0; j < v.items.length; j++) {
            var it = v.items[j];
            lines.push([escapeCSV(v.ticket), escapeCSV(v.fecha), escapeCSV(v.cliente || ""), escapeCSV(it.nombre), it.cant, it.precio, it.subtotal].join(","));
        }
    }
    saveFile(p, lines.join("\r\n")); return p;
}
function hacerBackup() {
    var appdir = asegurarDir(getAppDataDir()); var bkdir = appdir + "\\Backups";
    var ts = ymdhms(); var p = bkdir + "\\backup_" + ts + ".json";
    guardarEstado();
    var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
    fso.CopyFile(appdir + "\\estado.json", p);
    logLinea("Backup: " + p); return p;
}
function listarBackups() {
    var bkdir = getAppDataDir() + "\\Backups";
    var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
    if (!fso.FolderExists(bkdir)) return [];
    var f = fso.GetFolder(bkdir); var files = [];
    var en = new Enumerator(f.Files);
    while (!en.atEnd()) { var it = en.item(); files.push({ nombre: it.Name, fecha: it.DateCreated, tam: it.Size }); en.moveNext(); }
    return files;
}
function restaurarBackup(n) {
    var bkdir = getAppDataDir() + "\\Backups"; var src = bkdir + "\\" + n;
    var dst = getAppDataDir() + "\\estado.json";
    var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
    if (!fso.FileExists(src)) return false;
    fso.CopyFile(src, dst, true); logLinea("Restaurado: " + n); return true;
}
function limpiarBackupsViejos(dias) {
    var bkdir = getAppDataDir() + "\\Backups";
    var fso = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
    if (!fso.FolderExists(bkdir)) return 0;
    var f = fso.GetFolder(bkdir); var limite = new Date(); limite.setDate(limite.getDate() - (dias || 30));
    var borrados = 0; var en = new Enumerator(f.Files);
    while (!en.atEnd()) { if (en.item().DateLastModified < limite) { en.item().Delete(true); borrados++; } en.moveNext(); }
    return borrados;
}
var USUARIOS = [
    { user: "admin",   pass: "admin123",   rol: "ADMIN",   nombre: "Administrador"  },
    { user: "gerente", pass: "gerente123", rol: "GERENTE", nombre: "Gerente"        },
    { user: "operador",pass: "operador123",rol: "OPERADOR",nombre: "Operador"       },
    { user: "auditor", pass: "auditor123", rol: "AUDITOR", nombre: "Auditor"        }
];
function validarUsuario(u, p) {
    for (var i = 0; i < USUARIOS.length; i++) {
        if (USUARIOS[i].user === u && USUARIOS[i].pass === p) return USUARIOS[i];
    }
    return null;
}
function cambiarPassword(user, oldP, newP) {
    for (var i = 0; i < USUARIOS.length; i++) {
        if (USUARIOS[i].user === user && USUARIOS[i].pass === oldP) { USUARIOS[i].pass = newP; logLinea("Pass cambiado: " + user); return true; }
    }
    return false;
}
function login() {
    var intentos = 0;
    while (intentos < 3) {
        WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Usuario: "));
        var u; try { u = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { return null; }
        if (!u) return null;
        WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Password: "));
        var p; try { p = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { return null; }
        if (!p) return null;
        var user = validarUsuario(u, p);
        if (user) { WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Bienvenido " + user.nombre + " [" + user.rol + "]")); return user; }
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("Credenciales invalidas (" + (intentos+1) + "/3)")); intentos++;
    }
    return null;
}
function tienePermiso(user, accion) {
    var rol = user.rol;
    if (rol === "ADMIN") return true;
    if (rol === "GERENTE" && accion !== "USR_MGMT") return true;
    if (rol === "OPERADOR" && (accion === "VENTA" || accion === "CONSULTA" || accion === "BUSCAR")) return true;
    if (rol === "AUDITOR" && (accion === "REPORTE" || accion === "CONSULTA" || accion === "EXPORT")) return true;
    return false;
}
function topProductos(n) {
    var ventas = VENTAS; var counts = {}; var rev = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < ventas.length; i++) for (var j = 0; j < ventas[i].items.length; j++) {
        var it = ventas[i].items[j];
        counts[it.codigo] = (counts[it.codigo] || 0) + it.cant;
        rev[it.codigo] = (rev[it.codigo] || 0) + it.subtotal;
    }
    var sorted = []; for (var k in counts) sorted.push({ codigo: k, cant: counts[k], rev: rev[k] });
    sorted.sort(function(a, b) { return b.cant - a.cant; });
    return sorted.slice(0, n || 10);
}
function topClientes(n) {
    var ventas = VENTAS; var counts = {}; var rev = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < ventas.length; i++) { var c = ventas[i].cliente || "CF"; counts[c] = (counts[c] || 0) + 1; rev[c] = (rev[c] || 0) + ventas[i].total; }
    var sorted = []; for (var k in counts) sorted.push({ cliente: k, compras: counts[k], total: rev[k] });
    sorted.sort(function(a, b) { return b.total - a.total; });
    return sorted.slice(0, n || 10);
}
function reporteEjecutivo() {
    cli_limpiar();
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(tituloC("=== REPORTE EJECUTIVO ==="));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(dim("Generado: " + nowStr()));
    var totalVendido = 0; for (var i = 0; i < VENTAS.length; i++) totalVendido += VENTAS[i].total;
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Total vendido       : " + verde("$" + totalVendido.toFixed(2)));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Tickets emitidos    : " + VENTAS.length);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Items en catalogo   : " + CATALOGO.length);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Clientes registrados: " + CLIENTES.length);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("");
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(bold("--- TOP 10 ---"));
    var top = topProductos(10);
    for (var i = 0; i < top.length; i++) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  " + pad(String(i+1) + ".", 4) + pad(top[i].codigo, 12) + pad(String(top[i].cant) + " unid.", 12) + "$" + top[i].rev.toFixed(2));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("");
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("MD5 catalogo: " + integridadCatalogo());
}
function menuAdmin() {
    while (true) {
        cli_limpiar();
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(tituloC("=== MENU ADMINISTRADOR ==="));
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("1. Reporte ejecutivo");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("2. Exportar catalogo CSV");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("3. Exportar stock bajo CSV");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("4. Exportar ventas CSV");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("5. Hacer backup");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("6. Listar backups");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("7. Restaurar backup");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("8. Verificar integridad MD5");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("9. Top clientes");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("a. Limpiar backups viejos (30d)");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("b. Cambiar mi password");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("0. Volver");
        WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Opcion: "));
        var op; try { op = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { op = "0"; }
        if (op === "1") reporteEjecutivo();
        else if (op === "2") WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Catalogo: " + exportarCatalogoCSV()));
        else if (op === "3") WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Stock bajo: " + exportarStockBajoCSV()));
        else if (op === "4") WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Ventas: " + exportarVentasCSV()));
        else if (op === "5") WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Backup: " + hacerBackup()));
        else if (op === "6") { var bks = listarBackups(); WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Backups: " + bks.length); for (var i = 0; i < bks.length && i < 20; i++) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  " + bks[i].nombre + " (" + bks[i].tam + " bytes)"); }
        else if (op === "7") { WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Archivo: ")); var n; try { n = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { n = ""; } WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(restaurarBackup(n) ? ok("Restaurado") : errorC("No se pudo")); }
        else if (op === "8") WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(infoC("MD5: " + integridadCatalogo()));
        else if (op === "9") { var tc = topClientes(10); for (var i = 0; i < tc.length; i++) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(pad(String(i+1) + ".", 4) + padR(tc[i].cliente, 25) + tc[i].compras + " compras  $" + tc[i].total.toFixed(2)); }
        else if (op === "a" || op === "A") WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Eliminados: " + limpiarBackupsViejos(30)));
        else if (op === "b" || op === "B") { WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Pass actual: ")); var opx; try { opx = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { opx = ""; } WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Pass nuevo: ")); var npx; try { npx = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { npx = ""; } if (npx.length < 4) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("Min 4 chars")); else if (cambiarPassword("admin", opx, npx)) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Cambiado")); else WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("Pass actual incorrecto")); }
        else if (op === "0") break;
        cli_pausa();
    }
}
var VENTAS = [];
var CAJA_ACTUAL = 0;

function cli_limpiar() { try { var s = new ActiveXObject("WScript.Shell"); s.Run("cmd /c cls", 0, true); } catch(e) {} }
function cli_pausa()   { try { WScript.StdOut.Write("ENTER para continuar..."); WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) {} }
function cli_pad(n,w)  { var s = String(n); while (s.length < w) { s = " " + s; } return s; }
function cli_padR(n,w) { var s = String(n); while (s.length < w) { s = s + " "; } return s; }
function cli_linea(c)  { var out = ""; for (var i = 0; i < 78; i++) { out += c; } return out; }
function cli_now()     { var d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + cli_pad(d.getMonth()+1,2) + "-" + cli_pad(d.getDate(),2) + " " + cli_pad(d.getHours(),2) + ":" + cli_pad(d.getMinutes(),2) + ":" + cli_pad(d.getSeconds(),2); }
function nowStr() { return cli_now(); }
function pad(n,w) { return cli_pad(n,w); }
function rest_abrirMesa() {
    cli_limpiar();
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cyan("  ABRIR MESA"));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cli_linea("="));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Mesas libres:");
    var cnt = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < MESAS.length; i++) if (MESAS[i].estado === "LIBRE") { cnt++; WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  " + cli_pad(String(MESAS[i].numero), 4) + " cap:" + MESAS[i].capacidad + " " + MESAS[i].sector); }
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Numero de mesa: "));
    var nS; try { nS = parseInt(WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(), 10); } catch(e) { nS = 0; }
    var m = null; for (var i = 0; i < MESAS.length; i++) if (MESAS[i].numero === nS) { m = MESAS[i]; break; }
    if (!m) { WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("No existe")); cli_pausa(); return; }
    if (m.estado !== "LIBRE") { WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("Mesa " + m.estado)); cli_pausa(); return; }
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Comensales: "));
    var cS; try { cS = parseInt(WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(), 10); } catch(e) { cS = 1; }
    if (cS > m.capacidad) { WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(warnC("Capacidad mesa: " + m.capacidad + ". Continuar? s/N")); try { var r = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); if (!r || r.toLowerCase() !== "s") return; } catch(e) { return; } }
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Mozo (1-" + MOZOS.length + "): "));
    var mozS; try { mozS = parseInt(WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(), 10); } catch(e) { mozS = 0; }
    var moz = null; for (var i = 0; i < MOZOS.length; i++) if (MOZOS[i].id === mozS) { moz = MOZOS[i]; break; }
    m.estado = "OCUPADA";
    m.cuenta = REST_CUBIERTO * cS;
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Mesa " + m.numero + " abierta"));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(infoC("Cubiertos: " + cS + " x $" + REST_CUBIERTO + " = $" + m.cuenta));
    if (moz) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(infoC("Mozo: " + moz.nombre));
    cli_pausa();
}
function rest_tomarComanda() {
    cli_limpiar();
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cyan("  TOMAR COMANDA"));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cli_linea("="));
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Mesa: "));
    var nS; try { nS = parseInt(WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(), 10); } catch(e) { nS = 0; }
    var m = null; for (var i = 0; i < MESAS.length; i++) if (MESAS[i].numero === nS && MESAS[i].estado === "OCUPADA") { m = MESAS[i]; break; }
    if (!m) { WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("No esta ocupada")); cli_pausa(); return; }
    var carrito = []; var total = 0;
    while (true) {
        WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Plato (codigo/nombre, FIN para cerrar): "));
        var q; try { q = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { break; }
        if (!q) continue; if (q.toUpperCase() === "FIN") break;
        var f = []; for (var i = 0; i < PLATOS.length; i++) { if (PLATOS[i].codigo.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase()) >= 0 || PLATOS[i].nombre.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase()) >= 0) { f.push(PLATOS[i]); if (f.length >= 8) break; } }
        if (f.length === 0) { WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("Sin resultados")); continue; }
        for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  " + cli_pad(f[i].codigo, 12) + " " + cli_padR(f[i].nombre, 30) + " $" + f[i].precio);
        WScript.StdOut.Write("Cantidad: "); var cS; try { cS = parseInt(WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(), 10); } catch(e) { cS = 0; }
        if (!cS || cS < 1) continue;
        var p = f[0];
        var sub = cS * p.precio; total += sub;
        carrito.push({ codigo: p.codigo, nombre: p.nombre, cant: cS, subtotal: sub, precio: p.precio });
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Agregado: " + cS + " x " + p.nombre));
    }
    if (carrito.length === 0) return;
    m.cuenta += total;
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(infoC("Subtotal comanda: $" + total.toFixed(2)));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(infoC("Cuenta mesa " + m.numero + ": $" + m.cuenta.toFixed(2)));
    cli_pausa();
}
function rest_cerrarMesa() {
    cli_limpiar();
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cyan("  CERRAR MESA - Generar cuenta y ticket"));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cli_linea("="));
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Mesa: "));
    var nS; try { nS = parseInt(WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(), 10); } catch(e) { nS = 0; }
    var m = null; for (var i = 0; i < MESAS.length; i++) if (MESAS[i].numero === nS && MESAS[i].estado === "OCUPADA") { m = MESAS[i]; break; }
    if (!m) { WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("No esta ocupada")); cli_pausa(); return; }
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(infoC("Mesa " + m.numero + " | Sector: " + m.sector + " | Cuenta: $" + m.cuenta.toFixed(2)));
    var items = [{ codigo: "CUB-" + m.numero, nombre: "Mesa " + m.numero + " cuenta completa", cant: 1, subtotal: m.cuenta, precio: m.cuenta }];
    var tkt = formatearTicket(items, "Mesa " + m.numero, m.cuenta, 0, 21);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(""); WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(tkt);
    var rutaTkt = imprimirTicketGuardado(tkt, "rest_mesa");
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(infoC("Ticket: " + rutaTkt));
    var venta = { ticket: generarNumeroTicket(), fecha: nowStr(), cliente: "Mesa " + m.numero, items: items, total: m.cuenta };
    VENTAS.push(venta); logVenta(venta);
    m.cuenta = 0;
    m.estado = "LIMPIEZA";
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Mesa cerrada y en limpieza. Ingreso registrado."));
    cli_pausa();
}

// ============================================
// DEFINIÇÕES GLOBAIS WSH

var fs = new ActiveXObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject");
var wshell = new ActiveXObject("WScript.Shell");
var WSH = WScript;

// ============================================
// FUNÇÃO FORMAT
// ============================================


function format(str) {
    var args = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments, 1);
    return str.replace(/\{(\d+)\}/g, function(match, index) {
        return args[index] !== somnambulist ? args[index] : match;
    });
}

// ============================================
// MÓDULO: MSGBOX
// ============================================
var MessageBox = {
    WARNING: 48,
    ERROR: 16,
    Show: function(message, type) {
        var buttons = (type === this.WARNING) ? 4 : 0;
        var icon = (type === this.WARNING) ? 48 : 16;
        var result = wshell.Popup(message, 0, "MarkdownToHtml", buttons + icon);
        
        if (result === 6) {
            WScript.Echo("Clicou SIM");
            return "Yes";
        } else if (result === 7) {
            WScript.Echo("Clicou NÃO");
            return "No";
        } else {
            WScript.Echo("Clicou OK");
            WScript.Quit();
        }
    }
};

// ============================================
// MÓDULO: CONVERTER
// ============================================
var MarkdownToHtml = (function() {
    var PERMISSION_DENIED = 0x800A0046 | 0x100000000;
    var FILE_NOT_FOUND = 0x800A0035 | 0x100000000;
    var MARKDOWN_REGEX = /\.md$/i;

    function Converter(htmlLibraryPath) {
        this.htmlLibraryPath = htmlLibraryPath;
    }

    Converter.prototype.ConvertFrom = function(markdownPath) {
        if (!MARKDOWN_REGEX.test(markdownPath)) {
            MessageBox.Show(format('"{0}" is not a markdown (.md) file.', markdownPath), MessageBox.ERROR);
            return;
        }
        this.SetHtmlContent(
            this.GetHtmlPath(markdownPath), 
            this.ConvertToHtml(this.GetContent(markdownPath))
        );
    };

    Converter.prototype.ConvertToHtml = function(markdownContent) {
        var document = new ActiveXObject('htmlFile');
        document.open();
        document.write(this.GetContent(this.htmlLibraryPath));
        document.close();
        
        while (!document.parentWindow.showdown) {
            WSH.Sleep(1); 
        }
        return document.parentWindow.convertMarkdown(markdownContent);
    };

    Converter.prototype.GetHtmlPath = function(markdownPath) {
        var htmlPath = markdownPath.replace(MARKDOWN_REGEX, '.html');
        if (fs.FileExists(htmlPath)) {
            MessageBox.Show(
                format('The file "{0}" already exists.\n\nDo you want to overwrite it?', htmlPath), 
                MessageBox.WARNING
            );
        } else if (fs.FolderExists(htmlPath)) {
            MessageBox.Show(format('"{0}" cannot be overwritten because it is a directory.', htmlPath));
        }
        return htmlPath;
    };

    Converter.prototype.GetContent = function(filePath) {
        var FOR_READING = 1;
        try {
            var file = fs.OpenTextFile(filePath, FOR_READING);
            var content = file.ReadAll();
            file.Close();
            return content;
        } catch (error) {
            switch (error.number) {
                case PERMISSION_DENIED:
                    if (!fs.FolderExists(filePath)) {
                        MessageBox.Show(format('Access to the path "{0}" is denied.', filePath));
                    }
                    break;
                case FILE_NOT_FOUND:
                    MessageBox.Show(format('File "{0}" is not found.', filePath));
                    break;
                default:
                    MessageBox.Show(format('Unspecified error trying to read from "{0}".', filePath));
            }
        }
    };

    Converter.prototype.SetHtmlContent = function(htmlPath, htmlContent) {
        var FOR_WRITING = 2;
        var txtStream = null;
        try {
            txtStream = fs.OpenTextFile(htmlPath, FOR_WRITING, true);
            txtStream.Write(htmlContent);
        } catch (error) {
            if (error.number == PERMISSION_DENIED) {
                MessageBox.Show(format('Access to the path "{0}" is denied.', htmlPath));
            } else {
                MessageBox.Show(format('Unspecified error trying to write to "{0}".', htmlPath));
            }
        } finally {
            if (txtStream != null) {
                txtStream.Close();
            }
        }
    };

    return Converter;

function rest_reservar() {
    cli_limpiar();
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cyan("  RESERVAR MESA"));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cli_linea("="));
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Nombre: "));
    var nom; try { nom = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { nom = ""; }
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Fecha (YYYY-MM-DD): "));
    var f; try { f = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { f = ""; }
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Hora (HH:MM): "));
    var h; try { h = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { h = "21:00"; }
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Comensales: "));
    var cS; try { cS = parseInt(WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(), 10); } catch(e) { cS = 2; }
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Sector (Interior/Exterior/Patio/Vip/Barra): "));
    var sec; try { sec = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { sec = "Interior"; }
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Reserva " + nom + " - " + f + " " + h + " - " + cS + " comensales - Sector " + sec));
    cli_pausa();
}

  
function rest_verMenu() {
    cli_limpiar();
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cyan("  CARTA / MENU"));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cli_linea("="));
    for (var i = 0; i < REST_CATEGORIAS.length; i++) {
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(bold("--- " + REST_CATEGORIAS[i].nombre + " ---"));
        var cnt = 0;
        for (var j = 0; j < PLATOS.length && cnt < 10; j++) {
            if (PLATOS[j].categoria === i) {
                cnt++;
                WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  " + cli_pad(PLATOS[j].codigo, 12) + " " + cli_padR(PLATOS[j].nombre, 35) + " $" + PLATOS[j].precio);
            }
        }
        if (cnt === 10) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(dim("... y mas opciones"));
    }
    cli_pausa();
}
function rest_estadoMesas() {
    cli_limpiar();
    var libres = 0; var ocupadas = 0; var limpieza = 0; var reservadas = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < MESAS.length; i++) {
        if (MESAS[i].estado === "LIBRE") libres++;
        else if (MESAS[i].estado === "OCUPADA") ocupadas++;
        else if (MESAS[i].estado === "LIMPIEZA") limpieza++;
        else if (MESAS[i].estado === "RESERVADA") reservadas++;
    }
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cyan("  ESTADO DE MESAS " + nowStr()));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cli_linea("="));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Mesas libres     : " + libres);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Mesas ocupadas   : " + ocupadas);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("En limpieza      : " + limpieza);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Reservadas       : " + reservadas);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Total mesas      : " + MESAS.length);
    var pct = ((ocupadas + reservadas) / MESAS.length) * 100;
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Ocupacion        : " + pct.toFixed(1) + "%");
    cli_pausa();
}
function rest_reporte() {
    cli_limpiar();
    var totalVentas = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < VENTAS.length; i++) totalVentas += VENTAS[i].total;
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cyan("  REPORTE RESTAURANTE " + nowStr()));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cli_linea("="));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Platos en carta   : " + PLATOS.length);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Mesas             : " + MESAS.length);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Mozos             : " + MOZOS.length);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Clientes          : " + CLIENTES.length);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Mesas cerradas    : " + VENTAS.length);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("Ingresos totales  : $" + totalVentas.toFixed(2));
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("MD5 carta         : " + integridadCatalogo());
    cli_pausa();
}
function rest_buscarPlato() {
    cli_limpiar();
    WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Buscar plato: "));
    var q; try { q = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { q = ""; }
    var r = []; for (var i = 0; i < PLATOS.length; i++) { if (PLATOS[i].codigo.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase()) >= 0 || PLATOS[i].nombre.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase()) >= 0) { r.push(PLATOS[i]); if (r.length >= 30) break; } }
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(infoC("Resultados: " + r.length));
    for (var i = 0; i < r.length; i++) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  " + r[i].codigo + " - " + r[i].nombre + " - $" + r[i].precio);
    cli_pausa();
}
function rest_menuPrincipal(user) {
    while (true) {
        cli_limpiar();
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cli_linea("="));
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cyan("  RESTAURANTE EL GAUCHO - Sistema de Gestion v2.0"));
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(dim("Usuario: " + user.nombre + " [" + user.rol + "] | " + nowStr() + " | Ventas: " + VENTAS.length));
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(cli_linea("="));
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  1. Abrir mesa                          ");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  2. Tomar comanda                       ");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  3. Cerrar mesa (cuenta + ticket)       ");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  4. Reservar mesa                       ");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  5. Ver carta                           ");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  6. Estado de mesas                     ");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  7. Buscar plato                        ");
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  8. Reporte general                     ");
        if (tienePermiso(user, "REPORTE")) WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(amarillo("  9. Menu administrador                  "));
        WScript.StdOut.WriteLine("  0. Salir                               ");
        WScript.StdOut.Write(pregunta("Opcion: "));
        var op; try { op = WScript.StdIn.ReadLine(); } catch(e) { op = "0"; }
        if (op === "1") rest_abrirMesa();
        else if (op === "2") rest_tomarComanda();
        else if (op === "3") rest_cerrarMesa();
        else if (op === "4") rest_reservar();
        else if (op === "5") rest_verMenu();
        else if (op === "6") rest_estadoMesas();
        else if (op === "7") rest_buscarPlato();
        else if (op === "8") rest_reporte();
        else if (op === "9" && tienePermiso(user, "REPORTE")) menuAdmin();
        else if (op === "0") { guardarEstado(); break; }
        else WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("Invalida"));
        cli_pausa();
    }
}

try {
    var _user = login();
    if (!_user) { WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("Acceso denegado")); WScript.Quit(1); }
    logLinea("Login: " + _user.user);
    rest_menuPrincipal(_user);
    WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(ok("Sesion cerrada."));
} catch(e) { logError("main", e); try { WScript.StdOut.WriteLine(errorC("Error: " + e.message)); } catch(_e) {} }
